response.sql: WITH per_account AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS average_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), overall AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS average_transaction_count FROM per_account) SELECT p.account_id, p.average_amount, p.transaction_count, p.transaction_count * 1.0 / o.average_transaction_count AS transaction_count_ratio FROM per_account AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY transaction_count_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
